observed_current_behavior: evaluate_perception_head() transitively blocks computation only through _first_compute_blocker().
After successful compute, an ON downstream head returns memory_match_allowed=policy.memory_match_allowed and persistence_allowed=policy.persistence_allowed using only the downstream head policy.
The accepted test suite covers direct MEMORY_OFF and direct memory_allowed=false but contains no dependency-chain regression for upstream MEMORY_OFF or upstream persistence_allowed=false.
donor_semantics: Frozen donor evaluate_head() starts persistence_allowed from the current head policy and then sets it false when any declared upstream dependency has persistence_allowed=false.
Therefore a derived atom cannot regain persistence merely because its own head is ON when an upstream semantic dependency is MEMORY_OFF or otherwise persistence-denied.

minimal_counterexample.required_fail_closed_result: same-cycle egress may remain allowed, but memory_match_allowed=false and persistence_allowed=false for the derived result because the upstream dependency denies memory/persistence

risk: A MEMORY_OFF protected perception dimension can be transformed into a derived ON head and become persistable/memory-matchable again, defeating the intended non-persistence boundary even though direct-head tests remain green.
counterhypothesis: WP702 may intentionally scope dependency propagation to COMPUTE_OFF only. However the frozen donor explicitly propagates persistence denial across semantic dependencies, and the Triggerword-4 perception/privacy design treats policy as an information-flow boundary rather than a direct-head-only annotation.
